newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bank of NZ sells properties for NZ$18.84 mln.
newsitem.headline: Bank of NZ sells properties for NZ$18.84 mln.

text.p: Bank of New Zealand said on Tuesday it had sold 26 branch properties in Auckland for a total of NZ$18.84 million.
The branches will be leased back to the bank for a commercial lease period of six years, with ongoing rights of renewal.
Tuesday's auction was the first of three being held this week in Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch, offering a total of 45 bank properties for sale and lease back.
Agents Colliers Jardine are handling the sale of the portfolio, estimated to be worth more than NZ$25 million.
BNZ said the move reflected its strategy of focusing capital on developing core activities.
